name: Doki Doki Compatibility Quest III
source:
Doki Doki Compatibility Quest 3 is a visual novel playable in a browser, created to promote the release of Minecraft Pocket Edition v0.12.1 alpha. Players follow Winsten, a Windows 10 PC, as he attends his first day at Device High, a school for portable technology. There, he can meet and interact with Toshie the iPhone, Andy the Android device, and a Windows Phone named Dossie.

As Winsten meets each other student, he learns that he can enjoy the Minecraft: Pocket Edition experience with them, even though they’re running the mobile version and he’s Windows 10 Edition Beta. Each playthrough takes a few minutes, so you can see him arrange to play Minecraft with all three devices.

Minecraft Wiki page: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Doki_Doki_Compatibility_Quest:_3
translation:
《心跳相容性任務3》是一部可在瀏覽器中遊玩的視覺小說，用於宣傳《Minecraft：攜帶版》0.12.1 Alpha的釋出。玩家跟隨溫斯頓——一臺Windows 10電腦——參加可攜式科技學校「裝置高中」的第一天課程。在那裡，他會遇到並與iPhone女孩托希、Android裝置安迪以及名叫多茜的Windows Phone互動。

溫斯頓與每名學生相遇後，得知即使對方執行的是行動版、自己執行的是Windows 10版Beta，也能和他們一起體驗《Minecraft：攜帶版》。每次遊玩只需幾分鐘，可以看到他安排與三臺裝置一起玩《Minecraft》。

《Minecraft》Wiki頁面：https://minecraft.wiki/w/Doki_Doki_Compatibility_Quest:_3
